title: Why do we itch?
intro: Have you ever had an itch that you really wanted to scratch, but couldn't? Feeling itchy is unpleasant, and the feeling of finally scratching that itch can be very satisfying! But why do we feel itchy in the first place? And is it possible to catch an itch from someone else? Neil and Georgie discuss this and teach you some new vocabulary.
this_week_question: Listen to the recording of scratching on the programme (at 1:38). What is being scratched?
a) an arm b) a beard c) some jeans
Listen to the programme to hear the answer.

vocab.desc: unpleasant feeling on your skin / feeling something unpleasant on your skin scratch rub your nails back and forth against something, often to relieve an itch unpack explain in clear detail parasite animal, plant or fungus that lives on another lifeform and feeds on it spontaneously without being asked; without thinking catch (an illness/feeling) get an illness or feeling from someone else
